craft_notes: Sthāyin: means-graded making. Rows: worship then making. Read aloud: descending scale.

lines: Worship the god as you can afford, libate and sate, then give the thread —
wrought from gold-and-gem down to mere cloth-thread, cotton, kuśa-bellied.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra vibhavena devaṃ pūjayitvā āhutyā tarpayitvā pavitrakaṃ dadyāt sauvarṇamuktāratnaviracitāt prabhṛti paṭasūtrakārpāsakuśagarbhāntam api kuryāt
